name: What are common signs that my tile roof needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my tile roof needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating your tile roof needs repair include cracked, broken, or missing tiles, which can lead to leaks. Discolored ceilings or walls inside your home suggest water intrusion. Granule loss from concrete tiles, moss or algae growth, and sagging sections of the roof structure are also indicators. Regular inspections, especially after strong winds or storms, can help identify issues early before they cause significant damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cracked, broken, or missing tiles, interior water stains, granule loss, or visible sagging are common signs your tile roof needs repair.
